Any cause-of-death or suspect alibi clues? Morgan owns a .38 and had motive; Price/Rogers were in Miami.
C19 says Richardson owned .38, while C32 confirms Morgan and Lewis in Miami. Any decisive evidence or cause of death?
HQ confirms murder weapon was .38. Do we have motive/alibi clues for Morgan or Lewis?

Jamie shared C16: Lewis owned a .38 revolver. She and Morgan attended the Brexton cocktail hour after launch (C17), 45 minutes from Garden Hotel (C36). I don't yet have motive/alibi details for either.
C13 confirms Morgan owned the .38; C28 says King cut Morgan out of the deal. I haven't found a clear alibi for him. Any clues on Morgan or Lewis?
Found C13: search of Morgan's home revealed he owned a .38 revolver, matching the murder weapon. He also may have motive from the lost deal/extortion clues.

Morgan has grievance: King cut Morgan, Richardson and Carter out of lucrative deal (C28), and those three have frequent private meetings (C8). Lewis clue I found is seeking Brexton contract (C10); no weapon/alibi evidence from my searches.
Morgan was at Crown 7:50 then went directly to Brexton cocktail hour at Lakeside; Crown is 35 min and Lakeside 45 min from Garden. Any timing or evidence against Morgan?

Morgan's 7:50 Crown sighting followed by going directly to Lakeside seems to rule out reaching the Garden by 8. Rogers is still plausible: no alibi noted, and he owns a hatchet, but that's weak evidence.
C16 plus C10 makes Lewis a serious alternative: she had a .38 and a Brexton contract motive. Morgan's 7:50 Crown sighting weakens his opportunity, though it isn't conclusive.

Morgan's 7:50 sighting at Crown and then Lakeside makes him unlikely at Garden at 8; but Lewis also attended cocktail hour and owns a .38. We lack a decisive distinction, so I'm retaining Morgan given his motive and the consensus.
